Context: Full reimbursement - HPC cases

AD (R&H) shall be Member Secretary, who shall with the help of Sr. CMO of the Office of Additional DOG (HQ) shall issue meeting notices including notices to concerned Government Specialists and organize meeting for the Meetings of High Power Committee.  
The requests received up to the 15th of the month shall be placed before the Committee.  
If the High Power Committee does not recommend, the regret letters  
shall be 'issued explaining the reasons.
